steps.title: Fit
steps.body: No native connector; document-like policy content; cited answers required. Custom indexed connector.

steps.title: Content
steps.body: Published pages in scope. Comments deferred with the sponsor's agreement. Attachments over 64 MB are metadata-only.

steps.title: Permissions
steps.body: Group ACLs per page, including nested groups and AND rules. The source's admin bypass is not mirrored.

steps.title: People
steps.body: Email references for 97%; unmatched contractors handled by an approved map or excluded.

steps.title: Activity
steps.body: Not exposed by the API. Expect weaker ranking.

steps.title: Hosting and freshness
steps.body: Self-hosted in the customer's cloud project. Incremental every hour with tombstone deletes; full run nightly.
